name: INVTR2
title: Robust R^2 coefficient of determination
description:
This function computes a robust version of the R^2 coefficient of determination.
It is used internally by ``lmrobdetMM``,
and not meant to be used directly.

arguments.description: the proportional difference in loss functions (a naive robust R^2 coefficient).

family string specifying the name of the family of loss function to be used (current valid
options are "bisquare", "opt" and "mopt").

tuning parameters to be computed according to efficiency and / or breakdown
considerations. See `lmrobdet.control`, `bisquare`, `mopt`
and `opt`.
